package.name: cobraflex_launch_gui
package.description:
Qt launch manager for the workspace: lists the launch files of every sourced overlay workspace, edits their arguments, starts and stops them with one log pane per launch, and draws the live ROS graph (nodes and topics) and the TF tree.
It is a package of its own for the same reason as cobraflex_teleop_gui: PyQt5 and Graphviz stay out of the dependency set of cobraflex, which is installed on every machine of the stack, the Jetson included. Nothing else in the workspace depends on this one.
